entities.summary: Hennric David Yeboah was a Ghanaian businessman and politician. He was the Member of Parliament representing the Afigya Sekyere East constituency of the Ashanti Region of Ghana in the 4th, 5th, and 6th Parliaments of the 4th Republic of Ghana. He was a member of the New Patriotic Party.
